//: Composite indexes for the Firestore metrics backend (metrics/store_firestore.py). Only (owner ASC, timestamp DESC) is required -- get_recent_sessions' owner-filtered, timestamp-ordered query is rejected at runtime without it. Deploy with: gcloud firestore indexes composite create --project=<PROJECT> --collection-group=sessions --query-scope=COLLECTION --field-config field-path=owner,order=ASCENDING --field-config field-path=timestamp,order=DESCENDING
